checks.scope: Project profile schema, permissions, applicability, and normalized sandbox paths
checks.remediation: Fix the profile contract before running any quality mode.

checks.scope: Declared source roots, Git-tree membership, traversal, and symlink escape
checks.remediation: Keep every scanned source inside the authenticated declared source scope.

checks.scope: Tracked build outputs and forbidden artifact suffixes
checks.remediation: Remove generated build artifacts from the source checkout.

checks.scope: Compiler source membership in the authoritative Xcode build graph
checks.remediation: Make every compiled first-party source traceable to the declared Xcode graph.

checks.scope: New first-party compiler warnings in the selected build
checks.remediation: Resolve new first-party warnings or record an approved bounded exception.

checks.scope: Swift concurrency diagnostics and strict isolation violations
checks.remediation: Resolve compiler concurrency diagnostics at the correct actor or Sendable boundary.

checks.scope: Swift package and resolved dependency lock drift
checks.remediation: Regenerate and review the declared dependency lock from the approved toolchain.
Run the pinned formatter locally and commit the resulting formatting changes.

checks.scope: Pinned SwiftLint rules and custom deterministic violations
checks.remediation: Resolve lint errors using the repository-pinned SwiftLint configuration.

checks.scope: Tracked secrets, private keys, and credential-shaped material
checks.remediation: Remove secrets, rotate exposed credentials, and use approved secret storage.

checks.scope: Generated files and reproducible ownership markers
checks.remediation: Regenerate owned artifacts from the pinned generator or remove unowned output.

checks.scope: Localized key parity, format validity, and fallback coverage
checks.remediation: Synchronize localization keys and validate every localized resource format.

checks.scope: Asset catalogs, resource references, and forbidden binary outputs
checks.remediation: Fix missing, duplicate, invalid, or unowned resources before merging.

checks.scope: Tracked PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy structure, supported keys, value types, and bounded duplicates
checks.remediation: Fix malformed, unsupported, duplicate, or out-of-bounds privacy manifest structure; review API/data-use alignment separately.

checks.scope: Configuration, entitlements, signing, and release-sensitive file changes
checks.remediation: Review configuration and signing changes against the authorized release profile.

checks.scope: Explicitly disabled or unconditionally skipped tests in an explicitly declared test-source scope
checks.remediation: Restore the test or record an explicit applicability decision and owner.

checks.scope: Tracked TODO/FIXME markers without owner, ticket, or expiry
checks.remediation: Link the marker to an owner and ticket with a bounded expiry, or resolve it.

checks.scope: Architecture direction, literal policy, complexity, and possible god-object signals
checks.remediation: Review the signal in context; do not convert it to a blocking rule without a project contract.
